module.purpose: Provides React Flight server-side hook implementations and dispatcher for Server Components, managing thenable tracking and rejecting unsupported hooks.
module.summary: This file implements the server-side hooks dispatcher used by React Flight (Server Components). It exports functions to prepare and reset hook state per request and per component, and a HooksDispatcher object mapping React hook names to supported implementations (use, useId, useMemo, useCallback, useMemoCache, useCacheRefresh, useDebugValue) or stubs that throw because they are unsupported on the server. It tracks thenables (promises) used via use() to enable suspense, storing them in module-level state. The file also contains helpers for unsupported hooks/context and the core use() logic handling thenables, client references, and context types.
module.businessContext: Part of React's server rendering (Flight) for Server Components. Ensures hooks behave correctly on server; failure breaks SSR/Suspense.
functions: prepareToUseHooksForRequest (~L26-28): Sets current request for hook context.
resetHooksForRequest (~L30-32): Clears current request hook context.
prepareToUseHooksForComponent (~L34-43): Initializes thenable state and debug info per component.
getThenableStateAfterSuspending (~L45-58): Returns thenable state after suspend, stashing debug info.
getTrackedThenablesAfterRendering (~L60-64): Returns tracked thenables after rendering.
unsupportedHook (~L106-108): Throws error for unsupported server hook.
unsupportedRefresh (~L110-114): Throws error for unsupported cache refresh.
unsupportedContext (~L116-118): Throws error for client context read on server.
useId (~L120-127): Generates unique id for server component.
use (~L129-170): Implements use() API for thenables, client refs, context.

units.name: getThenableStateAfterSuspending

detail.name: getThenableStateAfterSuspending
postconditions: The module-level thenableState is set to null before returning.
In DEV mode, the returned state object has its _componentDebugInfo property set to currentComponentDebugInfo, and currentComponentDebugInfo is reset to null.
invariants: The returned state is always a ThenableState object (either the existing thenableState or a newly created one).
edgeCases: When thenableState is null (e.g. a thrown then suspended promise), an empty ThenableState is created via createThenableState().
stateMutations: Module-level thenableState is set to null.
Module-level currentComponentDebugInfo is set to null (only in __DEV__).
detail.summary: Returns the accumulated thenable state for the current component's suspension, stashing debug info in DEV mode and resetting the shared thenable state to null.

specLiterals.role: Marker value indicating thenableState has been consumed/reset after suspension

units.name: getTrackedThenablesAfterRendering

detail.name: getTrackedThenablesAfterRendering
preconditions: Must be called after rendering has occurred so that thenableState reflects the thenables tracked during that pass.
postconditions: Returns the current value of the module-level thenableState variable without modifying it.
edgeCases: Returns null when thenableState has not been initialized or was reset; returns an empty or populated Array<Thenable<any>> when thenables were tracked during rendering.
detail.summary: Returns the module-level thenableState value (either null or an array of tracked Thenable objects) that was accumulated during rendering, exposing the set of thenables whose resolution status was tracked for the current render pass.

specLiterals.role: Return type contract for the public API surface

specTests.then: the function returns that exact array reference

units.name: use

detail.name: use
postconditions: If usable is a thenable (has then function), returns the result of trackUsedThenable(thenableState, thenable, index).
If usable is a context, client reference, or unsupported type, does not return (throws).
invariants: thenableIndexCounter is incremented by exactly 1 for each thenable processed.
thenableState is initialized via createThenableState() if it was null before processing a thenable.
edgeCases: usable is null or a primitive (not object/function): not matched by first condition, not a client reference, throws 'An unsupported type was passed to use(): <usable>'.
usable is object with $$typeof === REACT_CONTEXT_TYPE: calls unsupportedContext() (which throws).
usable is a client reference with value.$$typeof === REACT_CONTEXT_TYPE: throws 'Cannot read a Client Context from a Server Component.'.
usable is a client reference without context: throws 'Cannot use() an already resolved Client Reference.'.
usable is a thenable (object/function with then): tracked and returned.
